_comment: Project config for developing claude-gates ITSELF. The runtime reads project → global, so this overrides the global config locally without touching it. These gates give false positives when editing the gates/hooks source of this very repo (they treat editing a gate as building a new tool, and protect the 'hooks/' path which is legitimate source here). Root fixes are in audit-before-build and reuse-before-build (existsSync = edit, not create); this config keeps development unblocked meanwhile and is the correct place for repo-specific gate tuning.
